title: Stream transcript (invalid): sequence number replay (seq=1 repeated)
description: Serialized SAR stream transcript with SESSION_INIT at seq=0, DATA_WRITE at seq=1, and a second DATA_WRITE also at seq=1. Sequence number replay violates the monotonic increment rule. Must be rejected with SAR_ERR_STREAM_STATE.
notes: This is a serialized SAR stream transcript, not an ordinary static archive.
Sequence continuity: seq=1 already accepted; second seq=1 is a replay.
Additional QUIC control streams are not covered here (future transport-vector work).
